## What this does

Drives the **landed** Round-10 evidence-first pipeline end-to-end over **one
composed fixture** against a real PostgreSQL 18 + PostGIS spine — the full path
**capture → claim → temporal/role resolution → eligible release → search/record
→ correction** — as a single executable proof.

- **`sig.composed-verification/1`** (`ops/composed_verify.py`, CLI
  `sig-ops composed-verify`): five legs over production code paths only
  (`PgClaimSink`, shared materializers, `run_spine_export`,
  `validate_release`/`activate`, released FTS5 index, serving barrier, durable
  intake + `intake_apply`). Emits `COMPOSED_VERIFICATION.json`/`.md`;
  `verdict=pass` only if **all 20 checks** pass; services that are unavailable
  are recorded, never silently green.
- **One composed fixture** (`docs/build/fixtures/p33-2_composed_fixture.json`):
  eligible CC-BY-4.0 + ODbL subjects, a withheld subject, an
  UNDETERMINED-rights subject, a restated count (temporal), an undated claim
  (occurrence fallback), publisher/operator/vendor roles, typed row locators.
- **`journey_verify.py`**: new optional `target_claim_id` — the correction
  journey now corrects a claim the composed release *actually published*
  (real claim/evidence digests in the review proposal; object-type-aware
  correction values); default behavior unchanged.
- **Committed proof** `docs/build/reports/p33.2-composed-verification/`:
  **verdict=pass, 20/20 checks**, publication
  `p-8414a4165a7866094922585e022be28c755f57da4a1bcb801071b0863e615ffe`,
  generated 2026-09-28T06:13:07Z @ `ad0bd84`.

## What the proof verifies (sampled approved results → end-to-end)

| leg | checks | key assertion |
|---|---|---|
| A capture→claim | 5/5 | `actual_capture` bindings + typed locators; re-sighting append-only (+0 claims, 2nd evidence link); atlas `document_only` honestly recorded |
| B temporal/role | 4/4 | pure model ≡ `sig.eligible_occurrence` SQL twin at two beliefs; undated → `capture_retrieved_at_latest`; publisher mints no entity |
| C eligible release | 6/6 | WITHHOLD recorded; +35/rerun +0; validate complete → activate; withheld + UNDETERMINED **loudly excluded** (`exclusions.json`); ODbL only in `osm_physical` |
| D search/record | 3/3 | FTS5 hit; record → claim anchors → evidence → fixture multihash; `route_access` + selector resolve `p-8414a416…` |
| E correction | 2/2 | intake journey 10/10 on the released claim; §16.6 close+revises; prior `sys_period` closed; exact-once retry |

Every result ties to **code** (`code_commit`), **inputs** (fixture sha256 +
capture multihash, connector fixture sha256) and **release identity**
(`publication_id`, manifest sha256) inside the proof JSON.

`sig-ops release-publish` **25/25** · spec byte-identical (143 ADRs, 715 ids) ·

build-memory **0 violations** — full matrix in `COMPOSED_E2E_REPORT.md`

**Isolation:** the proof mutates an append-only spine, so it always runs on a
**fresh scratch DB** (real `db/sqitch.plan`, dropped after); reruns on a dirty
catalog fail loudly instead of silently green.

- **Opened/closed:** none. Annotated `D-P31.1-1`/`D-P31.1-3` — their reserved

  half stays with OPEN `D-R10-LIVE-1`.
- **Stays OPEN:** `D-R10-LIVE-1`, `D-R10-PUBLISH-1`, `D-P32.23a-1` — fixture
  success is not a live pass; `live_verification=false` throughout.
- **Deviations:** none (`target_claim_id` is additive/optional; wire contracts
  unchanged). No ADR (composition, not a design decision); no sqitch change.
- **Not done by design:** no merge/tag/push-main, no source-rights flip, no
  live publication, no invented human work.
